failure.title: Browser acceptance harness leaked selection state and treated navigation cancellations as defects
failure.note: The retained Playwright traces show strict locator ambiguity and expected navigation-aborted requests being classified as browser runtime errors. Client-selection leakage was diagnosed in the same fix loop, but is not independently attributed to these retained traces.
failure.diagnosis: Acceptance journeys shared client selection state across browser contexts, locator assertions were not uniquely scoped, and the runtime guard could not distinguish expected navigation cancellation from a failed application request.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
